title: Project foundation
testKey: Click each project card. The clicked project should visibly highlight, while the three counters and all three status badges remain visible.
html:
PROJECT FOUNDATION

Projects

0Projects
0Active
0Open tasks
js: const label=p=>p.name||p.title||String(p.id||'Untitled project');const render=()=>{const projects=(api.getState('projects')||[]).slice(0,3);const activeId=api.getState('activeProjectId');const tasks=api.getState('tasks')||[];root.querySelector('[data-count=projects]').textContent=projects.length;const explicitActive=projects.filter(p=>String(p.status||'').toLowerCase()==='active').length;root.querySelector('[data-count=active]').textContent=explicitActive||projects.filter(p=>String(p.id)===String(activeId)).length;root.querySelector('[data-count=open]').textContent=tasks.filter(t=>String(t.status||'').toLowerCase()!=='done').length;const grid=root.querySelector('[data-project-grid]');grid.innerHTML='';projects.forEach((p,i)=>{const isActive=String(p.id)===String(activeId);const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.className='project-card';button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',isActive?'true':'false');const name=document.createElement('div');name.className='project-name';name.textContent=label(p);const meta=document.createElement('div');meta.className='project-meta';const badge=document.createElement('span');badge.className='status-badge';badge.textContent=p.status||'Ready';const selected=document.createElement('span');selected.className='selected-label';selected.textContent=isActive?'Selected':'';meta.append(badge,selected);button.append(name,meta);button.addEventListener('click',()=>{api.setState('activeProjectId',p.id);api.log(1,'Active project set to '+label(p));});grid.appendChild(button);});};render();const unsubscribe=api.subscribe(render);
